blind.description: A small cast-iron cauldron on three stubby legs, featuring ring handles on either side. Inside, it is filled with bright lime-green bubbling liquid with rounded surface bubbles, and a simple wooden stirring stick or ladle handle protrudes from the rim. The metal surface has a dark, weathered, slightly rusted finish, while the wood is plain warm brown.
blind.from_above: A dark circular rim framing vibrant green bubbling liquid, flanked by two side handle loops, with a brown wooden stick angled outward toward the upper right.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 to 2 feet tall (roughly one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.5 to 2 feet wide across the handles.
